Job interviews are officially insane now.

In this leaked interview footage, a candidate is literally told to keep their hands up so the interviewer can make sure they aren’t using AI — while companies themselves use AI to screen resumes, transcribe interviews, rank applicants, and eventually expect employees to use it at work.

So apparently AI is fine… just not when the applicant uses it.

Would you tolerate an interview like this?
